metadata.description: Local marketplace hosting the Forge issue-tracker CLI plugin and the code-quality rules it fires

plugins.name: forge
plugins.description: Drive a Forge issue tracker from the terminal — browse, read, file and comment over the MCP endpoint with no MCP client connected, writing every issue in natural Vietnamese through the bundled vi-natural CLI. Also the global half of the two-level rule arrangement: it guards the shell commands that cannot be undone, stops once before a memory or skill write, and routes every code file a call wrote — through Edit or through the shell — to the project's own eslint, whose rules stay the project's.

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Lint each supported file edited by Claude Code with the consumer project's local ESLint, comment-quality rules, god-file limits and design-token discipline. Forge fires these rules through its own hook; install this one to get them in a project that does not use Forge.
